cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: No Trouble at All
cards.instruction: Remain gracious and accommodating while making your growing inconvenience impossible to miss.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. I'll carry your book bag to the platform. My shoulder should manage one more staircase.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Let me take it. There are dictionaries in there.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. No, keep your hands free for the tickets. I'll change shoulders at the bottom.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They've moved our train to platform twelve, across the bridge.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course, lead the way. I'll give each shoulder a staircase and rest my fingers while you find our seats.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 and A3 professional wrappers do not supply handling expertise; shoulder management clearly exposes inconvenience while remaining accommodating.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 dictionaries and help offer cause A3 ticket division; B4 bridge causes A5 more shoulder/stair management.

relationship.evidence: B2 offers to take the heavy bag and B4 supplies a real platform change.

heightening.evidence: A5 graciously accepts the longer route while describing the increased burden in detail.

specificity.evidence: A1 bag and stairs, B2 dictionaries and B4 platform bridge make physical strain concrete.

brevityWit.evidence: A3 standard-again-slowly has no relevant technique and undermines the gracious voice.
